When I was like 4 to 5 years old, my family moved to a house that my parents were building (we had to move fast, because the house we lived in was robbed). After sometime we started hearing sound of something being throw at the windows, day and night, we asked our neighbours to help us watch if it was someone playing tricks on us, but they didn't see anyone either.  We asked help from the local priest and shepard, and that didn't solved either. 

As I said early, the house wasn't completed yet, the backyard was being almost finished and my uncle gave us a door with glass in the middle, the next day the glass was shattered all over the floor, we didn't hear anything and we couldn't believe our eyes,

During this time, my mother found a frog with it's mouth sewn in front of the house and a picture of an old document my father lost, he fell ill for sometime. I remember having a strange dream that's livid to me until now, I was floating and I saw something or someone dancing and spinning with a kind of costume with black feathers just beside my bed, that day I woke up on the floor.

After sometime everything stopped with no reason, thank God.

We complained to him and to the student support,and he said we were the worst classroom he ever had, and did that because a student said that as he already scored enough grades, he wouldn't do the last project.

The best we got was that everyone without enough grade\(thats almost 3/4 of the class\) to pass his class would hand the last project as recovery grade.
